title: Explanation Generation for Contradiction Reconciliation with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.22735v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing NLP work commonly treats contradictions as errors to be resolved by choosing which statements to accept or discard. Yet a key aspect of human reasoning in social and professional settings is the ability to hypothesize explanations that reconcile contradictions. For example, "Cassie hates coffee" and "She buys coffee everyday" appear contradictory, but are in fact compatible if Cassie was assigned the daily chore of buying coffee for all her coworkers. Despite advances in the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), their ability to hypothesize such explanations remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce the task of reconciliatory explanation generation, where models must generate explanations that effectively render contradictory statements compatible. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的矛盾调和解释生成
translated_abstract: 现有的自然语言处理（NLP）工作通常将矛盾视为错误，通过选择接受或丢弃哪些陈述来解决。然而，在社交和职业环境中，人类推理的一个关键方面是能够提出调和矛盾的假设性解释。例如，“Cassie讨厌咖啡”和“她每天都买咖啡”看似矛盾，但如果Cassie被指派了为所有同事购买咖啡的日常任务，这两者实际上是兼容的。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力取得了进展，但它们提出此类解释的能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了调和性解释生成任务，即模型必须生成能够有效使矛盾陈述变得兼容的解释。我们提出了一种新颖的重用自然语言推理（NLI）数据集的方法，并引入了可实现可扩展自动评估的质量指标。
tldr: 该论文提出了“调和性解释生成”新任务，通过重用自然语言推理（NLI）数据集的创新方法和可扩展的质量评估指标，使大语言模型能够生成让矛盾陈述变得兼容的解释，模拟人类推理中调和矛盾的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel task of reconciliatory explanation generation, proposing a new method of reusing NLI datasets along with scalable quality metrics to enable LLMs to generate explanations that render contradictory statements compatible, mimicking the human ability to reconcile contradictions.
